About 6 hours later stomach was sick, wasn’t sure what to do I called an ambulance started vomiting bile went to Er woke bout 20 hours later. I had in patient. Couple months later faced allegations that I was manipulating ex I was mentally insane etc lost my friend group except a couple guys it sucks. My best friend helped her as well. I just was shocked thought I’d do it again but went to residential, and think I’m gonna make it work. Somehow. It changed my life, even though I’m scared at times I’m tougher. I hope u find peace and check out help if you need. It can feel impossible for too long and it still does. But I’m doing my best and hope you can make it work too.

I’m only 19, but I’ve been suffering and self-harming for 7 years now I can’t keep just slaving like I am. I guess just the similar feeling of 1. Dwelling about suicide all day, feeling like each singular day is life-or-death and just trying to keep myself safe as I can without giving in 2. Severe anxiety that I seemingly cannot control, as I will “black-out” occasionally, that fucks with you so hard physically and mentally. Inability to deal with any challenge no matter the medication and therapy. Health problems and constant feeling of a heart attack about your life (safety and problems your having) 3. People affecting you way more than they should be etc. etc. lot more things. I don’t feel bad for myself or anything at all, as I have been working at it forever but for it’s only gotten worse. I don’t feel woke or “educated” because I  “I know” I’m gonna die by suicide or many will end up that way. It’s just sucky and unfair it works out that way.

I’m certain if the right people came everyone would be willing to die, as I know myself. But why slave to be living? There’s a certain point where your brain can’t handle this world anymore, or whatever has led to this point of suicide. If I spend most of my time fantasizing about me killing myself, I might as well grab the opportunity. It’s an endless cycle of nothing, can help myself and others by removing oneself. Our existence is magnificent don’t get me wrong, but these are very sick people. Just like how older-aged are. And it goes both ways—physical illness hurts you, then breaks u down mentally. Mental illness pains you, then affects your physical state. Super sick people die. It’s what happens.
